review.rule: Signs of the Last Hour. No date, no year and no countdown is given or implied, and the order among the signs is not established. Every hadith number reads 'No. —' until a reviewer pins it to a verified edition. The Mahdi is left out until his grading and details are decided by the review board.

signs.title: The Hour itself
signs.note: Its time is known only to Allah.

signs.title: The smoke
signs.note: Scholars differ on whether this verse speaks of a past or a future event.

signs.title: The Dajjal
signs.note: An authentic narration reports a false messiah who will appear before the Hour.

signs.title: The Beast of the earth
signs.note: The Quran states that a creature will speak to the people when the word is fulfilled.

signs.title: The sun rising from the west
signs.note: Scholars link the verse to this sign.

signs.title: The descent of Isa, son of Maryam
signs.note: Scholars interpret the verse as a sign of the Hour.

signs.title: Ya'juj and Ma'juj released
signs.note: The Quran states that the barrier will be broken before the promise comes.

signs.title: A landslide in the east
signs.note: One of three landslides in an authentic narration.

signs.title: A landslide in the west
signs.note: One of three landslides in an authentic narration.

signs.title: A landslide in the Arabian Peninsula
signs.note: One of three landslides in an authentic narration.

signs.title: A fire that gathers the people
The Trumpet and the Resurrection
signs.note: Follows the signs. The Quran states it is sudden.
